title: Canvas page template spec
description: Authored Canvas page template (page variant) format. Workbench normalizes this into an @json-render/react-compatible spec by synthesizing the canvas:component-tree root wrapper.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

label.description: Human-readable label of the page template.

description.description: Optional description of the page template.

status.description: Whether the page template is enabled. A default page template cannot be disabled.

default.description: Whether this page template is the site default. At most one enabled page template file may set this.

elements.description: Authored page template elements. Workbench preserves key insertion order when synthesizing canvas:component-tree children.
